ayahs.1: Tere paas jab munaafiq aate hain to kehte hain ke hum is baat ke gawaah hain ke beshak Aap Allah ke Rasool hain, aur Allah jaanta hai ke yaqeenan Aap us ke Rasool hain. Aur Allah gawahi deta hai ke yeh munaafiq qatan jhoote hain.
ayahs.2: Unhon ne apni qasmon ko dhaal bana rakha hai pas Allah ki raah se ruk gaye beshak bura hai woh kaam jo yeh kar rahe hain.
ayahs.3: Yeh is sabab se hai ke yeh imaan laa kar phir kaafir ho gaye pas un ke dilon par mohar kar di gayi. Ab yeh nahi samajhte.
ayahs.4: Jab Aap unhein dekh len to un ke jism Aap ko khushnuma maaloom hon, yeh jab baatein karne lagen to Aap un ki baaton par (apna) kaan lagaayen, goya ke yeh lakdiyan hain deewar ke sahaare se lagaayi hui, har (sakht) aawaz ko apne khilaaf samajhte hain. Yehi haqeeqi dushman hain un se bacho Allah unhein ghaarat kare kahaan se phire jaate hain.
ayahs.5: Aur jab un se kaha jaata hai ke aao tumhare liye Allah ke Rasool istighfaar karen to apne sar matkaate hain aur Aap dekhenge ke woh takabbur karte hue ruk jaate hain.
ayahs.6: Un ke haq mein Aap ka istighfaar karna aur na karna dono baraabar hai. Allah Taala unhein har giz na bakhshega. Beshak Allah Taala (aise) nafarmaan logon ko hidayat nahi deta.
ayahs.7: Yehi woh hain jo kehte hain ke jo log Rasoolullah ke paas hain un par kuch kharch na karo yahaan tak ke woh idhar udhar ho jaayen aur aasmaan-o-zameen ke kul khazane Allah Taala ki milkiyat hain lekin yeh munaafiq be-samajh hain.
ayahs.8: Yeh kehte hain ke agar hum ab laut kar Madina jaayenge to izzat wala wahaan se zillat wale ko nikaal dega. Suno! Izzat to sirf Allah Taala ke liye aur us ke Rasool ke liye aur imaan-daaron ke liye hai lekin yeh munaafiq jaante nahi.
ayahs.9: Ae Musalmano! Tumhare maal aur tumhari aulaad tumhein Allah ke zikr se ghaafil na kar den. Aur jo aisa karen woh bade hi ziyaan-kaar log hain.
ayahs.10: Aur jo kuch hum ne tumhein de rakha hai us mein se (hamari raah mein) is se pehle kharch karo ke tum mein se kisi ko maut aa jaaye to kehne lage ae mere Parwardigaar! Mujhe to thodi der ki mohlat kyun nahi deta? Ke main sadqa karun aur nek logon mein se ho jaaun.
ayahs.11: Aur jab kisi ka muqarrara waqt aa jaata hai phir use Allah Taala hargiz mohlat nahi deta aur jo kuch tum karte ho us se Allah Taala bakhoobi bakhabar hai.
